resources.string: The amplifier decodes Dolby and DTS sound (Atmos, DTS:X too); off: the player decodes it to PCM. From the next playback.
The formats sent as a bitstream when the HDMI device takes them; the others play as PCM.
The HDMI device takes no bitstream format (or it is not known)
%1$s (the HDMI device does not take it)
The TV / amplifier: Dolby Atmos where it takes TrueHD (silent where it does not: choose the box). The box: always heard, without Atmos. From the next playback.
Music at its own sample rate
The music player sends 44.1, 96 and 192 kHz stereo to HDMI as it is (16 bit), not converted to 48 kHz. Off: 48 kHz, as before. From the next track.
Multichannel music on the Zidoo engine (experimental)

A multichannel DSD file on a drive of the box (USB) goes to the Zidoo engine anyway; with this on, the other multichannel tracks (5.1 FLAC) too - it takes them only with Zidoo\'s own multichannel / SACD settings. Off: those play through Android (converted to PCM), as in Zidoo\'s music app with raw output.
